content:
You will be given an argumentation and will be asked about to annotate a specified sentence from it for it's argument components.
Annotate the argumentative parts of specified sentence with their argumentative roles such as pro (proponent), opp (opponent) using xml like tags to indicate start and end of a component.
Note that most of the sentences are argumentative. Annotate as much as you can.

Rent prices are already regulated in favour of tenants due to existing laws and the rent index. In view of the high prices for buying flats with existing rent contracts, these are an unattractive investment. Even if one might think that additional rent control is needed besides the current tenant protection, one should not deny longstanding owners the opportunity to adjust their returns to market level. A cap on rent increases upon tenant change is therefore not to be supported.
What argument components exists in sentence " A cap on rent increases upon tenant change is therefore not to be supported" from the above dispute? Please annotate the constituing words.
<pro>A cap on rent increases upon tenant change is therefore not to be supported</pro>
